campusPrototypeGraph.routeBasis: Imported Unity model walk-surface mesh, sampled on a 1.5 m lattice; Dijkstra by 3D world distance.
campusPrototypeGraph.buildingObstacleSource: WebXR/campus-building-obstacles.json: projected triangles exported from the eight loaded Unity building MeshFilters.
campusPrototypeGraph.obstaclePolicy: Outdoor graph nodes and links avoid projected imported building mesh triangles with a 0.3 m edge clearance. A named entrance003 mask preserves the checked front-gate approach; prototype interior links are explicitly tagged and limited to its rooms.

campusGeometry.method: Unity Editor renderer and transform inspection; source mesh AABB projections transformed through the master-scene GLTF import (X reflection plus Unity2Skfb root transform). AABBs are geometry extents, not walkable footprints.
campusGeometry.limitations: Six actual entrance transforms and three generic building bounds anchor the floor plan. The campus edge start, sector approach points, destination-to-sector assignments, exterior perimeter connectors and unverified sectors are inferred from the rendered asset. Destinations are distinct exterior candidate approaches, not room locations; paths are not surveyed or continuously walkability-validated. A south perimeter detour bypasses visible geometry on the east-side southern path. Route waypoints use a 2.6 m scene-ground estimate derived from the ground Grid collider bounds; the generic entrance transforms retain their original measured heights as separate geometry evidence. Entrance-sector 004 approach points are shifted south of a visible outdoor bin at the generic entrance marker.

routePlan.pathCenterlines: Inferred from visible internal pedestrian path loops and radial connectors in the imported Unity scene top view; not surveyed.
